messages:
olivia: heads-up — courier just dropped off a medium suitcase and an umbrella in the lobby for today's visitor. Front desk tried to print a visitor badge but the badge printer jammed. Guest asked if someone could grab a quick americano before the 3:30 meeting. Who can cover the badge + coffee? :umbrella: :luggage:
frontdesk: automated note — badge printer threw error E13, cleared the jam once but labels came out wrinkled on the 2nd try. We have the items on the top shelf by the reception desk.
jamal: I can come down in ~10 and sort the badge + coffee. @olivia who is the visitor (name + badge color)? :thumbsup:
olivia: guest is "Sofia R." arriving for 3:30. Please use a yellow visitor badge and write name on it. Leave the suitcase in a locker if we need to hold it.
maria: FYI row B hotdesk is full at 3pm — if Sofia needs a seat we'll need to reserve the quiet room or floating desk. Which do we prefer?
jamal: I'll bring an americano from the cafe. If we lock the suitcase, which locker + code should I use?
olivia: put it in Locker-7. Code:
```
1739
```
Also attach a temporary sticker: "Sofia R." and note on top. Front desk, can you confirm sticker's on?
frontdesk: sticker applied and taped to handle. Printer jam happened again after the third print, workaround was to switch to label font 'Condensed' in the web UI — prints cleaner.
dan: suggestion — can we add a quick auto-print step to the kiosk flow for guests so badges don't rely on manual prints? I'll spin up a small ticket for the infra team.
olivia: thanks all — @jamal huge help. If anyone else is nearby and can escort Sofia to Quiet Room 2 at 3:30 that'd be great. :coffee: (reaction: :sparkles: on the sticker)
jamal: on it, taking coffee + badge now. ETA 8 mins.
maria: I'll flag Quiet Room 2 for a 3:30 hold. thanks!
frontdesk: left a sticky note on Locker-7 with "Sofia R." and phone extension #402 in case courier comes back. All set.
file_notes: watercooler / office logistics: visitor check-in, badging, locker, and quick coffee request
